execution_review.rationale: The provider documents this as placing an order on the instrument's book. A limit order priced away from the book with post_only leaves resting order state and no fill, and the provider documents private/cancel as removing that exact order by id, so the effect is reversible inside one session without moving value.

The provider documents this as removing one open order identified by its order id. It is the reversal step of the order lifecycle, is scoped to an id this session created, and touches no order it did not place.

The provider documents this as cancelling all open orders and trigger orders across every currency and instrument kind. Cancellation cannot be undone, so a coverage call would destroy resting orders this session did not place — including another test's. Only per-order and per-label cancellation stay inside one session's own state.
